reviews.title: Amazing visuals
reviews.comment: Really amplified my work area! I was debating on the Glass variant but with my office having so much natural light I got the matte and I do not regret it.
reviews.author: JacksonH

reviews.title: Great idea and looks good but isn't,
reviews.comment:
Great display ruined by poor customer service and incomplete, buggy firmware. Might be better in the future but I'll be returning this in the next few days. 
Monitor randomly blacks out and requires you to cycle to inputs for it to wake back up. Doesn't actually support DP2.1 and is a pain to update firmware on.
reviews.author: ElizabethR

reviews.title: Great monitor in the short term
reviews.comment: Just ruined by a company that has terrible customer service … and a bad track record. Hoping that someone else buys them out to make them better. Monitor itself is great QoC not so much and longevity.. panel technology is slighty outdated there is better WOLED that lasts longer
